metadataRaces.scope: Owned responses in headless Edge; both bundles and both observer wrapping orders. No personal browser profile or real video download.

evidenceScope.extraControls: Invalid second XHR send and bounded-prefix 1 MiB XHR, across both bundles and observer orders
evidenceScope.deadline: Registered 30-second callbacks invoked deterministically; not a wall-clock expiry test
evidenceScope.engine: Owned headless Edge profiles for both bundle sources; Firefox engine untested
evidenceScope.memory: WeakRef and forced GC verify observer-owned copied buffers can be reclaimed. Not zeroization or a total browser-memory cap
evidenceScope.installation: Desktop remains 7.11; installed browser package 0.70.75; active personal-browser extension unverified
evidenceScope.remaining: Source authority for fresh clones of stale page metadata and legitimate in-place mutations; mixed-kind pressure; deployed browser workflow and paired IDM timing
